title: Knock Knuckle Gloves

sources.title: Knock
markers: | summary = It allows spellcasters to unlock non-magical locks.

summary: Gain +1 Sleight of Hand and cast Knock once per Long Rest.

fields.Knock: Action once per Long Rest, 60 ft. Open a mundane lock without a lockpicking check. Locks that explicitly resist Knock remain closed.
fields.Acquisition: High Security Vault 7 in the Counting House.
fields.Base value: 90 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Sleight of Hand: +1 to Sleight of Hand checks while wearing the gloves.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
